title: Makayla Asfaw Injured in Car Accident on FM 2657 in Burnet County, TX
description:
Burnet County, TX — December 1, 2025: Authorities reported that Makayla Asfaw was injured following a two-vehicle collision along Farm to Market Road 2657 at approximately 3:43 a.m. According to initial details, the crash occurred south of Copperas Cove near the intersection of FM 2657 and County Road 221. Investigators said 28-year-old Asfaw was traveling northbound in a Volkswagen Tiguan when it reportedly collided with a Ford F-150 traveling in the opposite direction under circumstances that have not yet been released. Officials indicated that both Asfaw and the other driver sustained injuries, though the extent of those injuries has not been specified. Additional details regarding the incident have not been made public. The incident remains under investigation.

Video by Brandon Green, Grossman Law Offices

More than 5,200 people came together in downtown Copperas Cove to celebrate the 2nd Annual #SHOPCOVE Oktoberfest, making it an unforgettable evening of community, culture, and fun.

Guests enjoyed live music from the Pivo & Polka Band, authentic German traditions including the Tapping of the Keg Ceremony, cultural performances, and crowd-favorite contests like the Bavarian Attire Contest, Yodeling Contest, Brat Eating Contest, Sausage Tossing Contest, and Stein Holding Contest.

From delicious food and cold brews to dancing, laughter, and friendly competition, Oktoberfest brought residents, visitors, businesses, and community partners together to celebrate everything that makes Copperas Cove special.

Thank you to our sponsors, partners, vendors, entertainers, and the thousands who joined us downtown to make this event such a success.

title: Why Would You Talk to a Lender First? #homebuying
description:
Why Would You Talk to a Lender First? #homebuying 

"Looking at homes is more fun than looking at your finances." Even though it isn't exciting, it is necessary before starting the home-buying process. Here are some key benefits: 
1. Understanding Your Budget
Pre-Approval Amount: Knowing how much you can borrow helps set realistic expectations for your home search.
Affordability: This helps you understand what monthly payments you can afford, including taxes and insurance.
2. Improving Your Negotiating Position
Pre-Approval Letter: A pre-approval letter shows sellers you're a serious buyer and can make your offer more attractive.
Faster Offers: Being pre-approved allows you to act quickly when you find the right home.
3. Saving Time
Targeted Search: Focus your search on homes within your budget, saving time and effort.
Streamlined Process: Reduces the risk of falling in love with a home you can’t afford.
4. Understanding Loan Options
Loan Types: Learn about different mortgage options (fixed-rate, adjustable-rate, FHA, VA, etc.) and find what suits you best.
Interest Rates: Give you a sense of current interest rates and how they affect your purchasing power.
5. Identifying Financial Issues Early
Credit Check: Address any credit issues before they impact your ability to get a loan.
Debt Management: Understand how your debt-to-income ratio affects your loan eligibility.
6. Setting a Down Payment Plan
Down Payment Requirements: Know how much you need for a down payment and plan accordingly.
Assistance Programs: Learn about available down payment assistance programs if needed.
7. Peace of Mind
Confidence: Start your home search with confidence, knowing you have a clear financial plan.
Reduced Stress: Avoid surprises during the buying process by understanding your financial situation upfront.
8. Better Collaboration with Your Realtor
Clear Communication: Your realtor can better assist you if they know your budget and financial constraints.
Focused Efforts: Enables your realtor to show you homes that meet your financial criteria.

title: Never Forget Real Estate: How To Stay On Top Of The Market #realestate
description:
Never Forget Real Estate: How To Stay On Top Of The Market #realestate 

Keeping real estate in mind is important for several reasons, whether you're a homeowner, a prospective buyer, or an investor. Here are some key points to consider:

1. Investment Opportunities
Wealth Building: Real estate can be a powerful tool for building long-term wealth through property appreciation and rental income.
Diversification: Including real estate in your investment portfolio can help diversify your assets and reduce risk.
2. Personal Financial Stability
Equity Growth: As you pay down your mortgage, you build equity in your home, which can be a valuable financial asset.
Tax Benefits: Homeownership can provide tax benefits, such as deductions for mortgage interest and property taxes.
3. Market Trends
Informed Decisions: Keeping an eye on real estate market trends helps you make informed decisions about buying, selling, or investing.
Timing: Understanding market cycles can help you time your transactions to maximize benefits.
4. Lifestyle Considerations
Quality of Life: Owning a home can provide stability and a sense of community, impacting your overall quality of life.
Customization: Homeownership allows you to customize your living space to fit your needs and preferences.
5. Retirement Planning
Downsizing: As you approach retirement, you might consider downsizing to reduce expenses and free up equity.
Income Stream: Rental properties can provide a steady income stream during retirement.
6. Economic Impact
Local Economy: Real estate transactions stimulate the local economy, supporting jobs in construction, real estate services, and home improvement.
Property Taxes: Property taxes fund essential community services such as schools, police, and infrastructure.
7. Hedge Against Inflation
Asset Appreciation: Real estate often appreciates in value over time, outpacing inflation and preserving purchasing power.
Rental Income: Rental income can increase with inflation, providing a reliable source of income that keeps pace with rising costs.
8. Wealth Transfer
Generational Wealth: Real estate can be passed down to future generations, providing financial security and continuity.
Estate Planning: Including real estate in your estate planning can help ensure your assets are distributed according to your wishes.
9. Personal Satisfaction
Homeownership Pride: Owning a home can bring a sense of pride and accomplishment, enhancing personal satisfaction and well-being.
Community Engagement: Homeowners often become more engaged in their communities, fostering stronger neighborhoods and social ties.
10. Flexibility and Control
Control Over Living Environment: Homeownership provides greater control over your living environment compared to renting.
Future Planning: Owning real estate gives you the flexibility to make long-term plans without the uncertainties of rental agreements.
By keeping real estate in mind, you can better navigate financial decisions, enhance your quality of life, and build a solid foundation for the future.

title: What You Need To Know: The Dangers Of Market Timing #realestate
description:
What You Need To Know: The Dangers Of Market Timing #realestate 

Trying to "time the market" when selling a home—waiting for the perfect moment to list based on market conditions—comes with several risks and downsides. Here are the key disadvantages:

1. Market Conditions Are Unpredictable
Real estate markets can shift quickly due to factors like interest rate changes, economic downturns, or natural disasters. Even experienced professionals struggle to predict the best time to sell with absolute certainty. By waiting, you could miss an unexpectedly favorable window.

2. Opportunity Cost
While waiting for a better market, you may be missing opportunities to reinvest or buy your next home. If prices rise during that time, the financial benefit of waiting could be canceled out by higher costs elsewhere.

3. Holding Costs Add Up
The longer you hold on to a property, the more you incur ongoing expenses like mortgage payments, property taxes, insurance, and maintenance. If the market doesn’t shift in your favor soon, these holding costs can erode your profits.

4. Missed Buyer Demand
The “right time” to sell isn’t always about market conditions—it’s also about buyer demand. If interest rates are low and buyers are actively looking, it might be better to sell even if the market isn’t peaking. Waiting could mean missing out on motivated buyers.

5. External Factors Could Force a Sale
Unexpected life changes—like a job relocation, financial hardship, or family needs—may require you to sell sooner than planned. If you were waiting for a perfect market and now need to sell under pressure, you might have fewer options.

6. Emotional Stress and Uncertainty
Trying to perfectly time the market can create stress and frustration. Constantly monitoring trends, second-guessing decisions, and worrying about missing the peak can take a toll emotionally.

7. Renovations Could Lose Value Over Time
If you’ve made improvements or staged your home, waiting too long could diminish their appeal. A fresh renovation today might feel dated in a few years, requiring additional investments before listing.

8. Inventory Levels Can Shift
If you delay listing, more homes might enter the market, increasing competition. A well-timed sale in a low-inventory market can generate more interest and better offers than waiting for a market that becomes saturated.

9. Interest Rates May Rise
Higher mortgage rates can reduce buyer affordability, which can lead to lower offers or fewer buyers overall. Even if home prices increase, fewer buyers might be able to meet those prices in a high-rate environment.

10. Your Next Move Might Be Impacted
If you plan to buy another home after selling, waiting too long could backfire if prices in your desired area increase. What you gain on the sale might be offset by a higher purchase price elsewhere.

Conclusion
While timing the market can be tempting, focusing on your personal needs, the current level of buyer activity, and market fundamentals often leads to a better outcome than waiting for the perfect moment. If your property is ready to sell and your personal circumstances align, it’s often wiser to move forward rather than gambling on future conditions.

title: First Impressions Matter When Selling #realestate
description:
First Impressions Matter When Selling #realestate 

Maintaining your lawn when selling your home offers several key benefits, helping you make a great first impression and increase your chances of a successful sale. Here’s why it matters:

1. Boosts Curb Appeal
Your lawn is one of the first things potential buyers see. A well-kept yard gives the impression that the home has been properly maintained, creating positive expectations before buyers even step inside.

2. Makes Photos Stand Out
High-quality photos are essential for online listings. A lush, green lawn enhances your property’s visual appeal in photos and makes it more likely to catch the eye of buyers scrolling through listings.

3. Sets Your Home Apart
In competitive markets, small details like a well-maintained lawn can set your home apart from others on the market. It signals to buyers that your property is move-in ready, increasing interest.

4. Creates a Welcoming Atmosphere
Buyers want to envision themselves living in the home. A tidy lawn with fresh-cut grass, trimmed bushes, and maybe even some colorful flowers makes the space feel inviting and livable.

5. Minimizes Buyer Concerns
An overgrown or patchy lawn can raise concerns about other maintenance issues within the house. Buyers may assume that if the exterior isn’t well-kept, the interior could also need work.

6. Supports Higher Offers
Small investments in lawn care can lead to higher offers. A beautiful lawn adds perceived value to the property and helps justify your asking price in the minds of buyers.

7. Enhances Outdoor Spaces

A: Persistent pet odors, heavily stained carpets, torn sod in the backyard, and chewed baseboards are the top deterrents for Central Texas buyers, particularly incoming military personnel who require move-in-ready homes.

description:
KILLEEN, Texas (KWTX) - 7th Heaven Smoke Shop in Killeen said it is tightening up security measures after the store was robbed at gun point.

Owner Natasha Mayhorn told KWTX that a man entered the store wanting to buy a pipe at about 6 p.m. on Sept. 3.

He followed the store’s employee behind the counter, pulled out a gun and demanded money from the cash register.

“Horrible. I’m very insecure. I’ve been having mixed feelings. Do I even want to keep the store or do I want to let it go” They just took the money for our bills,” said Mayhorn.

title: Buc-ee’s Near Fort Hood – A Texas Road Trip MUST!
description:
🚗 Stop at Buc-ee’s – The Ultimate Road-Trip Pit Stop Near Fort Hood!

Hey everyone! Hanna here, your local advisor and military spouse from the Fort Hood area. Today we’re taking a quick tour of the legendary convenience-store-meets-travel-center that is Buc-ee’s!

📍 Whether you’re PCSing, relocating for duty, or just passing through central Texas, Buc-ee’s is one stop you don’t want to skip.

Why Buc-ee’s is a must-stop:
Founded in 1982 in Texas, Buc-ee’s set out to provide a “clean, friendly, and in-stock” experience no matter where the store is. 

It’s more than a gas station: huge store with tons of fuel pumps, a bakery, snack aisles, BBQ, specialty merchandise, and yes — famously super-clean bathrooms. 
Wikipedia

Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Perfect for early morning drives, late shifts, PCS moves, or family road trips from Fort Cavazos. 

Unique Texas-flavored goodies: think kolaches, smoked brisket sandwiches, Beaver Nuggets (the puffed corn snack), and Buc-ee’s branded gear. 

What to hit while you’re there:
-Fuel up: lots of pumps, including options for diesel and other fuel types.
-Grab some snacks for the road — kid-friendly, travel-friendly.
-Check out the merchandise: hats, shirts, plushies, tumblers — great for gifts or souvenirs.

-Use the restroom (yes, we mention it because they really are that clean 😉).

If time allows: enjoy the bakery or BBQ section for a pit-stop meal.

For military families and PCSing:
If you’re coming into the Killeen area, this could be a friendly stop after the long drive, or a place to introduce newcomers to Texan travel-culture. We (both myself and Taylor) get the pace, the logistics, and the need for a smooth stop.

This stunning 88+ acre ranch in Coryell County offers the perfect blend of rural tranquility and convenient access. Located just five miles from Copperas Cove, you’ll enjoy the peace and quiet of country living while still being close to town, with easy access from paved FM 1113.

title: Why settle for one stream of income? Invest in multifamily properties and your wealth grow faster
description:
There are many ways to invest many of them include single family homes however if you need to live in the home I recommend house hacking! 

Choosing to invest in multifamily properties over single-family homes is a strategic move for building wealth. With multifamily, you can generate multiple streams of rental income from a single investment, which accelerates cash flow and reduces financial risk. 

Expenses like maintenance and property management can be spread across units, making it more cost-effective. Additionally, multifamily properties often appreciate in value, creating long-term equity. This investment offers the potential for both passive income and significant growth, allowing you to scale your portfolio faster and achieve financial freedom sooner

title: Home Inspection VS. Appraisal
description:
🏡 Home Inspection Vs. Appraisal: What's the Difference?

As a home buyer, you'll likely include two contingencies in your offer: a home inspection and an appraisal. So, what sets them apart?

A home inspection gives you insight into the safety and condition of the home, allowing you to negotiate any needed repairs. On the other hand, an appraisal, usually requested by your lender, determines the home's value based on comparable properties to ensure you're not overpaying. Both are crucial in making an informed purchase.

For more details on these processes and how they benefit you, reach out to my team and me. We’re here to guide you every step of the way.

🏡 Want to Boost Your Net Worth? Homeownership Could Be the Key! 💰

Did you know that owning a home can significantly improve your financial future? 🌟 Right now, more than ever, homeownership isn't just about having a place to live—it's one of the smartest financial moves you can make.

Hi, I’m Gloria Miller with REAL Broker and McElroy Property Group, and I’m here to share why homeownership could be your ticket to building lasting wealth! 🔑

A recent report from the National Association of Realtors shows that the average homeowner’s net worth is roughly 40 times greater than that of a renter. Yes, you read that right—40 times! 💥

So, how does this happen? When you own a home, you're building equity every month as you make mortgage payments. That means you're investing in YOUR future—every payment you make is helping you grow your financial security. 💸

Renters, on the other hand, are paying someone else’s mortgage and not building any equity in return. 🏚️💔

Even with all the ups and downs of the housing market, homeownership is still one of the most reliable ways to build wealth over time. Did you know that even George Washington became wealthy through real estate? He started as a surveyor and used land investments to grow his fortune. 💡

Here’s the deal: While you rent, you’re not investing in YOUR future the same way you are when you’re paying off a mortgage. But when you own a home, you’re investing in an asset that can appreciate in value and continue to grow your wealth as you pay down your loan.

title: What is Homestead Tax Exemption
description:
Hello Texas Homeowners! Don’t forget to take advantage of the Homestead Tax Exemption available to you. This exemption can significantly reduce the taxable value of your primary residence, potentially saving you money on your property taxes. 

✅ Who qualifies?
Homeowners who occupy the property as their primary residence as of January 1st.
You must apply for the exemption if you’ve recently purchased or moved into your home.

title: What Is House Hacking?
description:
🏡💡 Ever heard of House Hacking?

It’s one of the smartest ways to build wealth through real estate — even with a small investment! 👏
Here’s how it works:
➡️ Buy a home as your primary residence
➡️ Put as little as 3% down
➡️ Live there for 1–2 years (2 years is ideal unless life happens 😉)
➡️ Then… you’re eligible to buy another one! 🙌

That’s what I did! I downsized to a smaller home with my daughter, and as my real estate biz grew, so did our needs — so I upgraded again! 📈

House hacking = living smart while investing in your future.
Are you ready to start?

However, it also faces significant challenges, and the long-term preservation of this remarkable city is a matter of global concern. 
A day trip from Milan to Venice is possible, but it will be a long day with a lot of travel time involved. If you're short on time and don't mind a busy day, it can be a worthwhile experience to get a taste of this unique and beautiful city. However, to fully appreciate Venice, consider an overnight stay if your schedule permits.

It serves as the resting place of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, founder and first President of the Turkish Republic. Designed by architects Emin Onat and Orhan Arda, the construction of Anıtkabir began in 1944 and was completed in 1953. In addition to the mausoleum, the complex consists of various structures and monuments, as well as a wooded area known as the Peace Park.

title: New Texas Law Could Cost Realtors $$$ – SB 140 EXPLAINED!
description:

This law covers calls, texts, photos, videos, and electronic messages. Violating SB 140 isn’t just a slap on the wrist—it could mean lawsuits, attorney’s fees, and even triple damages.

In this video, I break down what’s changing, what’s at risk, and how you can protect yourself (and your license). I’ll also show you how a CRM can help you stay compliant without losing touch with your clients.

title: How do I know my home is priced right?
Pricing isn’t one number.
description:
Most sellers think pricing is one number. It's actually four, and picking the wrong one quietly costs you.
Here's the real math nobody explains. For any home there's a range, not a single "correct" price. Price at the top and you might squeeze more, but you'll likely sit longer and risk chasing the market down. Price toward the bottom and you'll move with more competition, but you may leave money on the table. In between sit the tiers where most of the strategy actually lives.
None of those is automatically right. The right tier depends on your timeline, your equity, and how much certainty you want. That's a decision only you can make, and only if someone shows you all four honestly instead of selling you the highest one just to win your listing.
That's what I lay out. Four tiers, the tradeoff on each, and what each one likely means for your days on market and your bottom line. Then you choose with your eyes open.

title: Same House Different Strategies.
description:
Same house. Same market. Same week. Two different list prices, and about $15,000 difference in what the seller actually kept.
That's not a trick. That's just what happens when pricing is treated like a guess instead of math.
Price too high and the house sits. Sitting costs you carrying payments, and it costs you leverage, because buyers watch days on market and they know a stale listing means you'll take less. By the time you drop the price and finally close, you've paid for that optimism twice.
Price it right on day one and something different happens. Buyers show up while the listing is still fresh, you get real interest instead of lowballs, and you negotiate from strength. That's where the difference gets made. Not in the list price, in the net.
The list price is the number that gets attention. The net is the number that hits your account. Those are not the same thing, and only one of them matters to you.

description:
🏡🚧 Buying a New Build? STOP & Ask These 5 Questions First! 🚧🏡

Before you sign on the dotted line, make sure you know exactly what you’re getting into! Here are 5️⃣ must-ask questions to protect your wallet 💰👇

1️⃣ What’s included?
That “starting price” might not cover the lot, upgrades, or even landscaping! 🌱💸 Always ask for a breakdown.

2️⃣ Who pays closing costs?
Some builders offer incentives, but it’s not guaranteed! 💲💬 Negotiate upfront.

3️⃣ Can I use my own realtor?
YES! 🙌 The builder has already factored in commission, so having a pro on your side costs you NOTHING—just be sure to mention your realtor on your first visit! 🏡🔑

4️⃣ How much is due at signing?
Deposits for the home, lot, & upgrades can add up FAST. ⚠️ Plus, some may be non-refundable! Always check.

5️⃣ Are there HOA fees or extra taxes?
Hidden costs like HOA fees & special assessments can make your monthly payments 📈—know before you commit!

✨ Buying new construction is exciting, but don’t go in blind! With the right questions (and the right realtor 😉), you can secure the best deal with confidence.

title: Buying a Home with an HOA? WATCH & READ THIS FIRST #HOATips #HomeBuyingChecklist #TexasRealEstate
description:
🏡 Think you’ve found the perfect home?
If it’s in an HOA neighborhood, don’t sign yet! ✋
Ask these 6️⃣ key questions first — the wrong HOA can cost you 💸, stress you out 😩, and limit your freedom 🚫.

👇 Smart buyers always ask:

1️⃣ How much are the monthly fees & what do they cover?
💰 Fees can vary a lot — are you paying for a pool, lawn care, or just rules?

2️⃣ How often do the fees go up?
📈 A “good deal” now might double later — check past increases!

3️⃣ Any special assessments coming?
⚠️ If reserves are low, surprise charges could be around the corner 🧾

4️⃣ What are the design or renovation rules?
🎨 Can you paint your house, build a deck, or plant a tree? Better ask!

5️⃣ Are rentals allowed?
🏘️ Some HOAs ban short-term rentals or limit long-term leases — it matters!

6️⃣ What’s the HOA’s financial health?
📊 Ask for their budget + reserve study. Red flags = low savings & big repairs

🔑 Bottom line:
✅ A solid HOA protects your home + boosts value
❌ A bad one = stress, $$ loss, & no freedom

🎯 Top 5 Things to AVOID After Applying for a Mortgage 🏡❌

1️⃣ Don’t switch bank accounts 🏦Keep your accounts steady! Lenders need to track your funds easily.

2️⃣ Don’t open or close credit accounts 💳🚫Any change to your credit can affect approval — no new cards, no closures!

3️⃣ Don’t make big purchases 🚗🛋️Hold off on buying that car or new furniture. It could mess with your debt-to-income ratio.

4️⃣ Don’t co-sign loans ✍️⚠️You’ll take on more debt — and lenders will notice.

5️⃣ Don’t make large, unexplained deposits 💰❓Lenders need clear documentation. Unverified deposits = delays.

title: Price Cut vs Closing Costs: Which Saves You More? #realestate  #realestatetips #mortgagetips

One of my buyers was ready to make an offer on a home that had been sitting on the market for a few weeks.

She asked:
👉 “Should I offer $15k below the list price? Or offer full price and ask the seller to cover $15k in closing costs?”

✨ Here’s what we figured out together:

Both offers would look the same to the seller — but they’d feel ᴠᴇʀʏ different to her monthly payment and her pocketbook.

👉 If she offered $15k under asking, she’d save about $80/month on her payment.
👉 If she offered full price and used that $15k to buy down her rate + cover closing costs, she could save $200+/month AND keep more cash on hand after closing.

Same house. Same net to the seller. 𝐖𝐚𝐲 𝐛𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫 outcome for her.

Right now, strategy is ᴇᴠᴇʀʏᴛʜɪɴɢ when writing offers — especially in a market where buyers are payment-conscious.

We ended up writing full price with concessions. 🤞 Now we wait!

description:

Becoming a homeowner comes with some 𝘀𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗼𝘂𝘀 𝘁𝗮𝘅 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗸𝘀 — and knowing them can save you big every year. 💸

State & local property taxes may be deductible — a major benefit for Texas homeowners.

Some upgrades may qualify for 𝘁𝗮𝘅 𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗱𝗶𝘁𝘀, especially energy-efficient improvements.

✨ 𝗛𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝗢𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻

description:
That time between going under contract and doing your inspection?
It’s not downtime — it’s go-time. ⚡🏠
These next few days can make your transaction smooth ✨ or stressful 😵‍💫.

Here’s what smart buyers 🧠🔍 do before the inspector even shows up:

1️⃣ 𝗚𝗲𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗿’𝘀 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝘆 𝗗𝗶𝘀𝗰𝗹𝗼𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗲 📄
Gives you insight into known issues, repairs, and history. Use it to guide your inspector on what to double-check.

2️⃣ 𝗦𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗹𝗲 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗜𝗠𝗠𝗘𝗗𝗜𝗔𝗧𝗘𝗟𝗬 📆
Don’t wait! Good inspectors book fast. You need room for follow-ups if red flags pop up.

3️⃣ 𝗥𝗲𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄 𝗛𝗢𝗔 𝗱𝗼𝗰𝘀 / 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗼 𝗱𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰𝘁 𝗶𝗻𝗳𝗼 🏘️
Look for rules, fees, restrictions. 🚫 rental limits, 🎨 paint rules, 🚗 parking issues — surprises here = $$ later.

4️⃣ 𝗖𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁 ☎️🛡️
Get a quote & confirm no coverage issues (like old roofs or past water damage). If insurance is pricey or unavailable → you need to know ASAP.

5️⃣ 𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗯𝘆 𝗮𝘁 𝗱𝗶𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗱𝗮𝘆 🚗⏰
Neighborhood vibes at 8 AM vs. 10 PM = totally different. Check noise, parking, and the overall feel after the excitement settles.

6️⃣ 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝗮 𝗾𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿 📝🔍
Strange smell? Sloping floor? Odd noise? Write everything down so nothing gets missed.

✨ This is your window to investigate, verify, and prepare.

title: 👉 Things Buyers Regret After Closing 😬 #homebuyertips #realestatetips #killeentx #forthood
description:
Central Texas home buyers 👇

Everyone focuses on the big expensive things during a showing (roof, HVAC, plumbing).

But the things that actually determine whether you’ll love living there are the smaller details people miss.

1️⃣ Check your phone signal in every room.
A dead zone where you plan to work or stream gets annoying fast.

2️⃣ Look at the sunlight next.
If that bedroom faces east… you’re waking up with the Texas sun every morning.

3️⃣ Stand in the kitchen and count the outlets.
If you’re already thinking about extension cords, that’s a sign.

4️⃣ Walk into the garage and actually pull the car in.
Can two vehicles fit comfortably?

5️⃣ Try every lock and deadbolt.
Small issues now turn into annoying repairs later.

6️⃣ Open every window.
Stuck windows often mean maintenance you didn’t plan for.

7️⃣ Turn on the shower and faucets upstairs.
Water pressure matters more than fancy tile.

8️⃣ Look at the light fixtures.
Tall people + low hanging lights = daily frustration.

9️⃣ Think about laundry.
Is it upstairs, downstairs, or across the house?

🔟 Walk the property lines.
Know exactly where your yard ends before dealing with fence disputes later.

A good realtor should be pointing these things out.
If the tour is just “wow look at this space,” you’re missing the real evaluation.

You’re not just buying a house.
You’re buying your daily life.

When you use a VA loan with a 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝘃𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗻 who isn’t your spouse:

▪️ Both borrowers can use their qualifying income 💵

▪️ The VA guaranty applies only to the 𝗩𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗻’𝘀 portion of the loan ⚠️

For example, on a 𝗦𝟮𝟬𝟬,𝟬𝟬𝟬 home with a 50/50 split, the Veteran’s portion would be $100,000.

Because the non-veteran’s portion is not VA-guaranteed, the lender may require a 𝗦𝟮𝟱,𝟬𝟬𝟬 down payment — that’s 𝟭𝟮.𝟱% of the purchase price. 🤯💰

Exact requirements may vary based on entitlement, ownership percentage, and lender guidelines.

title: Over 65 | Temple ISD Election 2026
description:
There will not be an increase in taxes for senior citizens or disabled persons as a result of these propositions. School property taxes for senior citizens and disabled persons are frozen and would not be affected by passage of Prop A and Prop B as long as the homeowner has applied for and received the Over 65 Homestead Exemption with the Bell County Appraisal District. Your ISD taxes will not exceed the frozen dollar amount.
 
There will also be a Proposition on the November ballot to increase the homestead exemption to two hundred thousand dollars for homeowners 65 and over.

The ballot language can be confusing. Since 2019, state law has required school districts to have the phrase” THIS IS A PROPERTY TAX INCREASE” in the ballot language for all bond propositions. However, homeowners aged 65 and older or disabled persons who have applied for and received the Over 65 Exemption will not see an increase over their frozen dollar amount if there have been no major improvements or additions to their home. Check your most recent Notice of Assessed Value Change to see if you will be impacted.

More information on Prop A and Prop B is available on the district’s website at T-I-S-D dot org slash Election 2025.

Early voting runs October 20th through October 31st and Election Day is November 4th. Please exercise your right to vote and make your voice heard in this election.

title: Killeen Housing Authority Director Sentenced 3 Years After $70K Embezzlement for Luxury Spending
description:
On January 17, 2024, Deadra Johnson — a former Executive Director of the Killeen Housing Authority in Killeen, Texas, who held the position from January 10, 2019, until her resignation in August 2022 — was arrested by federal authorities after a grand jury indicted her on nine counts of embezzlement and one count of making false statements under 18 U.S.C. § 641 and 18 U.S.C. § 1001. Johnson pleaded guilty on February 11, 2025, to one count of theft of government property, and on November 18, 2025, U.S. District Judge David Counts sentenced her in Waco federal court to 37 months in federal prison, three years of supervised release, and $297,473.30 in restitution. During her tenure, Johnson fraudulently diverted HUD-funded Killeen Housing Authority accounts to pay her personal rent, utilities, auto maintenance, internet service, first-class airline tickets, furniture, and down payments on two personal vehicles, concealing the scheme through multiple kickback arrangements with KHA contractors and vendors. The original nine-count indictment charged just under $70,000 in documented losses, but the federal investigation's broader reconstruction of the fraud scope produced the $297,473.30 restitution figure — nearly four times the charged amount — reflecting conduct that spanned her entire tenure. The Killeen Housing Authority, which served hundreds of low-income and military families in Bell County through several hundred thousand dollars in annual HUD funding, became defunct following Johnson's resignation and the ensuing federal investigation, leaving residents without the housing assistance they had depended on.

In today’s video, we’re counting down the 10 Most Dangerous Towns in Texas, 2025. Whether you’re planning a move or just curious, you’ll want to stick around… because some of these names might surprise you.
